title: BlockActions
description: A unique plugin that allows you to prohibit any enchantments by levels, block the placement and breaking of blocks, and restrict crafting by items and slots.
body: A unique plugin that allows you to restrict any enchantments by levels, block block placement and breaking, and limit crafting by items and slots. It works with permissions (LuckPerms, PEX, and others), is fully configurable through .yml files, and supports Minecraft 1.16 versions.
